title: RHEL Patch with Pre/Post Checks and Report
description: Validates memory, filesystem free space, and running services before updating all packages and rebooting a RHEL server, then validates again and emits a structured report.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution.

parameters.name: target_server
parameters.description: The RHEL server hostname or IP address to patch and validate.

parameters.name: min_free_mem_mb
parameters.description: Minimum required free memory in megabytes before and after patching. Recommended default is 2048 (2 GB).

parameters.name: min_free_disk_gb
parameters.description: Minimum required free disk space in gigabytes for each non-excluded filesystem before and after patching.

parameters.name: fs_exclude_list
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of mount points to exclude from filesystem free space checks.

parameters.name: fs_type_exclude_list
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of filesystem types to exclude from filesystem free space checks.

parameters.name: reboot_timeout_seconds
parameters.description: Maximum time to wait for the target server to come back online after reboot.

playbook_output.description: Emits pre/post free memory, pre/post low-space filesystem lists, running services before and after, service mismatch lists, update/reboot statuses, per-check statuses, and overall status.

fields.name: pre_memory_status
fields.description: Pre-update memory check status: OK or FAIL.

fields.name: pre_disk_status
fields.description: Pre-update filesystem free space check status: OK or FAIL.

fields.name: post_memory_status
fields.description: Post-update memory check status: OK or FAIL.

fields.name: post_disk_status
fields.description: Post-update filesystem free space check status: OK or FAIL.

fields.name: service_comparison_status
fields.description: Service list comparison status: MATCH or MISMATCH.

fields.name: update_status
fields.description: Package update status: OK or FAIL.

fields.name: pre_free_memory_mb
fields.description: Free memory in MB before the update.

fields.name: post_free_memory_mb
fields.description: Free memory in MB after the reboot.

fields.name: pre_disk_issues
fields.description: Comma-separated list of pre-update filesystems below the free space threshold; empty string if none.

fields.name: post_disk_issues
fields.description: Comma-separated list of post-update filesystems below the free space threshold; empty string if none.

fields.name: pre_running_services
fields.description: Comma-separated list of running services before the update.

fields.name: post_running_services
fields.description: Comma-separated list of running services after the reboot.

fields.name: service_mismatch_stopped
fields.description: Comma-separated list of services that stopped after reboot; empty string if none.

fields.name: service_mismatch_started
fields.description: Comma-separated list of new services started after reboot; empty string if none.

fields.name: overall_status
fields.description: Overall status: SUCCESS, COMPLETED_WITH_ISSUES, or FAILED.

steps.name: Gather pre-update system facts
steps.function: Collect system facts, including memory and mounted filesystem information, from the target RHEL server before applying updates.

steps.name: Parse pre-update free memory
steps.function: Extract total free memory in MB from the pre-update facts and determine whether it meets the minimum threshold.

computations._pre_free_memory_mb: Extract free system memory in MB from _pre_facts as an integer.
computations._pre_memory_status: Set to 'OK' if the pre-update free memory in MB is greater than or equal to min_free_mem_mb, otherwise 'FAIL'.

steps.name: Check pre-update free memory
steps.function: Stop the playbook before updating if the pre-update free memory is below the configured minimum threshold.
steps.condition: Pre-update memory check status is FAIL.

steps.name: Identify pre-update low-space filesystems
steps.function: Evaluate mounted filesystems before update, excluding configured mount points and filesystem types, and list those below the minimum free space threshold.

computations._pre_disk_issues: From _pre_facts, list mount points not in fs_exclude_list, whose filesystem type is not in fs_type_exclude_list, and whose available space in gigabytes is below min_free_disk_gb. Return a comma-separated string of mount_point (free_gb GB) entries, or an empty string if none.
computations._pre_disk_status: Set to 'FAIL' if _pre_disk_issues is non-empty, otherwise 'OK'.

steps.name: Check pre-update filesystem free space
steps.function: Stop the playbook before updating if any non-excluded filesystem has insufficient free space.

steps.name: Gather pre-update running services
steps.function: Collect systemd service facts from the target RHEL server before applying updates.

steps.name: Extract pre-update running service names
steps.function: Create a sorted list of services that are currently running on the target RHEL server before the update.

computations._pre_running_services: From _pre_service_facts, produce a comma-separated sorted list of service names whose state is running.

steps.name: Update all installed packages
steps.function: Update all installed packages on the target RHEL server using the native package manager.

steps.name: Reboot the server and wait for it to come back
steps.function: Reboot the target RHEL server and wait for it to return online using the idempotent reboot module.

steps.name: Gather post-update system facts
steps.function: Collect system facts, including memory and mounted filesystem information, from the target RHEL server after the reboot.

steps.name: Parse post-update free memory
steps.function: Extract total free memory in MB after the reboot and determine whether it meets the configured minimum threshold.

computations._post_free_memory_mb: Extract free system memory in MB from _post_facts as an integer.
computations._post_memory_status: Set to 'OK' if the post-update free memory in MB is greater than or equal to min_free_mem_mb, otherwise 'FAIL'.

steps.name: Identify post-update low-space filesystems
steps.function: Evaluate mounted filesystems after reboot, excluding configured mount points and filesystem types, and list those below the minimum free space threshold.

computations._post_disk_issues: From _post_facts, list mount points not in fs_exclude_list, whose filesystem type is not in fs_type_exclude_list, and whose available space in gigabytes is below min_free_disk_gb. Return a comma-separated string of mount_point (free_gb GB) entries, or an empty string if none.
computations._post_disk_status: Set to 'FAIL' if _post_disk_issues is non-empty, otherwise 'OK'.

steps.name: Gather post-update running services
steps.function: Collect systemd service facts from the target RHEL server after the reboot.

steps.name: Extract post-update running service names
steps.function: Create a sorted list of services that are currently running on the target RHEL server after the reboot.

computations._post_running_services: From _post_service_facts, produce a comma-separated sorted list of service names whose state is running.

steps.name: Compare pre/post services and derive statuses
steps.function: Compare pre- and post-update running service lists to identify stopped services, started services, and the overall service comparison status.

computations._service_mismatch_stopped: List the service names present in _pre_running_services but absent from _post_running_services, as a comma-separated sorted list; empty string if none.
computations._service_mismatch_started: List the service names present in _post_running_services but absent from _pre_running_services, as a comma-separated sorted list; empty string if none.
computations._service_comparison_status: Set to 'MATCH' if both mismatch lists are empty, otherwise 'MISMATCH'.

steps.name: Compose final report statuses
steps.function: Calculate update status, reboot status, and overall status from the stored update/reboot results and post-check statuses.

computations._update_status: Set to 'OK' if the package update result indicates no failure, otherwise 'FAIL'.
computations._reboot_status: Set to 'OK' if the reboot result indicates no failure, otherwise 'FAIL'.
computations._overall_status: Set to 'SUCCESS' if post_memory_status is 'OK', post_disk_status is 'OK', and service_comparison_status is 'MATCH'; otherwise set to 'COMPLETED_WITH_ISSUES' because pre-checks, update, and reboot have already succeeded to reach this point.

steps.name: Emit final report
steps.function: Print the Required Output Format <result> block with pre/post memory, disk, service, update, reboot, and overall status fields.

steps.name: Emit error and fail
steps.function: Reached via the playbook's rescue block on any task failure or a failed pre-check; prints the Required Error Output Format block and fails the play.

phases.name: Pre-checks
phases.description: Collect pre-update facts and running services, and validate memory and filesystem free space before changing the system.

phases.name: Main action
phases.description: Update all installed packages and reboot the target RHEL server.

phases.name: Post-checks
phases.description: Collect post-update facts and running services, compare them to pre-update state, and compute final report statuses.

phases.name: Reporting
phases.description: Emit the structured final report to standard output.

phases.name: Error handling
phases.description: Reached when any step fails or a pre-check fails; reports the error and halts execution.
